instruction: Can you help me rename the "client_files_Apr" folder on the desktop to "client_files_May"?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires renaming directory from 'client_files_Apr' to 'client_files_May'. Evaluator checks if the renamed directory exists using shell command. This variation uses monthly client files pattern.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly checks both requirements of a rename operation: (1) target directory 'client_files_May' exists AND (2) source directory 'client_files_Apr' no longer exists
The bash command '[ -d ~/Desktop/client_files_May ] && [ ! -d ~/Desktop/client_files_Apr ] && echo 'Rename successful.' || echo 'Rename failed.' properly distinguishes rename from copy operations
exact_match metric correctly compares command output with expected 'Rename successful.\n' string
Complete coverage: All requirements in the instruction are verified by the evaluator
